Dialogs.Dialog: You know, I just thought of a really good idea. Will you hear me out？
What's up？ All formal like that...
Want to go there sometime？ Um, on a date.
Huh... it's rare for ▲高嶺＊＊▲ to come up with a new date spot.
...Huh？ That's, you know... right！ You're always the one planning, so I thought I'd do it for once.
That's right, yes！ I think Enoshima is a lovely place！ See, you can go on a day trip, the fish looks delicious, and, um... it's Shonan！
Sure. If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wants to go, let's go！
I'll study up properly, okay？ On Enoshima！ Hehe, I can't wait.
(▲高嶺＊＊▲ must really want to go.)
▲高嶺＊＊▲... you seem kind of different today...？
Yeah, all dressed up, I mean...
Yes, I came way too early.
▲高嶺＊＊▲... you're a little dressed up again today？
That's, well, because I thought you'd take pictures again... Meanie.
You look like you're having fun, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Yes. I was just listening to the sound of the VVVF inverter control.
This car is the new 500 series, so it has a VVVF inverter. Hear that whirring sound when it starts moving？
Hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, were you always this into trains？
Not really, but I looked up the Enoden for today.
Yes. The blue car that was just stopped there.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s totally hooked on the Enoden, huh？
It's not that, but I looked it up before, remember？ I learned all sorts of things then, so I can't help noticing.
I see. The 10 series... there are other kinds too, right？
That's right. Even just the ones in service, there are lots. The popular 300 series, the 1000 series, the 2000 series...
Phew, we made it～ So this is Enoshima...
Yes. Nice weather... I'm glad it's sunny for our first trip to Enoshima.
Apparently you can see it well from Katase-Enoshima Station, but not really from the Enoden's Enoshima Station.
I see. So to get to the sea...
This way. Straight down this road, a three-minute walk. Let's go？
As expected of ▲高嶺＊＊▲！ Let's go！
Hehe, that's right. But I'd like to walk slowly. I'm sure there are lots of things we don't know yet.
It looks so much closer than I imagined... From here, it looks just like a picture postcard.
Yeah. You can see it so well...
And it really looks like a dragon god lives there.
Enoshima has been a place of worship since before Prince Shotoku's time, and En no Gyoja and Hojo Tokimasa also came to pray to the island's dragon god.
Haah～！ You can see the island so well today too.
The first time we came, I was so busy reviewing everything I'd studied in my head that I didn't notice.
Actually, I've been starving for a while...
Enoshima has lots of delicious food, right？ I couldn't decide what to do, but...
I'll eat it, I'll eat it！
You're not forcing yourself？ If you want to try the local specialties, I can just take the bento home.
Local specialties go in a separate stomach.
Geez... then let's find somewhere we can spread out the bento？
Okay. Where should we go first...
Yes. That's the place to start, after all？
Yes. It was nothing special. I'm glad you ate it.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s bento goes in a separate stomach too！
Geez... hey, want to see the Samuel Cocking Garden next door？
Okay, about time for that place...
We're going to ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲, right？
Next has to be that place...
Want to go to ▲スポット名＊＊＊＊＊＊▲？
Come to think of it, you mentioned a dragon god earlier. There are pictures of a dragon with lots of heads all over Enoshima, huh？
Among the treasures of Enoshima Shrine is a scroll recording the legend, called the Enoshima Engi. The heavenly maiden and the five-headed dragon in it are the motif.
Does the heavenly maiden punish the dragon or something？
Hehe, too bad. The answer is, the dragon that brought disasters fell in love with the heavenly maiden...
The dragon promised to repent, and from then on, wore itself down protecting people from disaster, and the dragon and the heavenly maiden lived happily ever after.
That's how it goes！ But really, with ▲高嶺＊＊▲ around, who needs a tour guide？
Oh, no... I just looked a few things up.
Mitsu-Uroko, the one with three triangles lined up？ It's used all over, huh？
That's because it's the crest of the Hojo family, who are connected to the island.
It comes from three dragon scales Hojo Tokimasa received when he prayed to the island's dragon god.
Hojo Tokimasa, huh... sounds like something out of a history textbook.
Hojo Tokimasa, wasn't he in our textbook？
Yes. He was. ...I really am like a textbook.
Since we were coming, I wanted to make the most of it, so I looked up all sorts of things... but maybe that was the wrong way to go about it.
Walking up the approach full of delicious smells, getting excited, worrying what we'd do if Benten got jealous...
Yes. But if we'd come without looking anything up, getting lost together, wondering about things together... I'm sure it would've been more fun...
It is. And that side of you is very ▲高嶺＊＊▲, and I like it.
No... I love you because you're kind.
So many slopes and stairs... walking here never gets boring, does it？
But it's good training, right？ It works the muscles you don't normally use.
Okay, lift those knees higher, keep it up▼
Hehe！ If you climb this approach, you reach the first shrine of Enoshima Shrine.
So many souvenir shops and tasty-looking stuff！
Yes. Apparently it's been bustling as a tourist spot since the Edo period, with people coming to pray to Benten.
Huh... it's got a lot of history, huh？
There was a bronze torii at the entrance of the approach, right？ That was built in the 4th year of Bunsei, too.
You sure know a lot. Could it be, that too...？
Yes, I looked it up a little.
A little, huh... as expected of ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
The name's hard to read... of course you looked this one up too, right？
Hetsunomiya is one of the three shrine buildings of Enoshima Shrine, and it's famous for enshrining Myoon Benzaiten, one of the three great Benten of Japan.
Yes, she's also called the Naked Benten. There's a legend that if married couples or lovers come, she gets jealous and breaks them up...
It's fine. This shrine is said to bless relationships. See all the pink ema plaques people have offered？
Huh... ema for couples. Oh, people wrote all kinds of stuff. Let's see, what does it say？
No！ Geez... it's rude to read them.
The Samuel Cocking Garden, huh. Wow... it's beautiful. Is this where Mr. Samuel Cocking lived or something？
That's not it. It was originally a botanical garden, but when it was renovated in 2002, the Meiji-era Irish trader――
No... hey, want to climb the lighthouse？
Whoa... it's pretty high. You can see so far...
Really, the sea and the town are so pretty... And the sea breeze feels so nice.
You know, I'm only just now realizing what a wonderful place this is.
I see... I'm glad we came, huh？
It's always so lively here, isn't it？ Like a festival.
And whenever we come, it always smells so good, huh？ Want to eat something？
Hmm... Enoshima is a special exception. Hehe！
All right！ What should we get？
Then, turban shell, whole-octopus crackers, oh, and whitebait crackers, and then...
Wait... are you okay eating that much？
We'll split them. So it's fine. Okay？
Benten has such a pure white, beautiful face.
Right！ I've never seen such a beautiful goddess.
...▲高嶺＊＊▲, you're acting kind of weird？
Could it be you believe the legend about Benten getting jealous？
Not really... but it still bothers me.
Hey, we're climbing the lighthouse, right？
You can see all of Shonan...
Izu, Hakone, the Tanzawa range... That's Yuigahama, right？ And Inamuragasaki, Miura... ah, I can even see Boso！
As expected. You even looked up the view.
Huh？ I didn't look up anything in particular...
(Right. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ was always a natural at this stuff...)
It's written with "dragon," but read "wadatsumi," right？
"Wadatsumi" is an old word for the god of the sea. But his face is kind of cute, isn't it？
Oh, right. I'm sorry, Dragon God.
Haah... we went down a lot of stairs...
Hehe, look, it's not much farther to the caves！
It's cool in here, as I thought...
Yes... now it's a tourist attraction like this, but...
...when it was still just a natural cave, it must have been an even more solemn place...
People used to come here for ascetic training, right？
Yes. When Kobo Daishi visited, Benten is said to have appeared.
Yes, uplift of the seabed and erosion from the waves made layers run in all directions... hehe♪
Glad you're having fun... we went down a lot of stairs to get here.
Yes. On the way up, shall we race to see who reaches the top first？ Let's go！
(▲高嶺＊＊▲... sometimes I can't keep up...)
▲主人公＊▲. Ah, this spot might be good for pictures...
Ah, here. It really feels like Enoshima.
Hey, want to take a picture to remember today？
I don't know, but it's probably a trick of the light from the sun's position and the lens...
Ah... could it be, the wonderful thing ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s mom was talking about...
!! Then we'll surely... Let's treasure this forever, okay？
Yeah, you look like the heavenly maiden...
This is a secret just between us too, right？
Okay... the sun's starting to set.
Yes... we have to go home soon.
No... there's just something I'm curious about... ah, over there.
Before we go, can we stop by for a bit？
Hey... will the sunset be pretty today too？
Yeah, it'll be pretty, I bet？
Before we go home, I want to go there again. ...Okay？
Ah, right. All right, let's go！
What a sunset... is that the Bell of Dragon Love？
Yes... that bell is called the Bell of Promise. Inspired by the legend of the heavenly maiden and the dragon, they say lovers who ring it will be bound together forever.
Doesn't it remind you of something？ Before, the two of us...
Oh... Aijo Point. Could it be that's why you wanted to come to Enoshima？
Yes, that's part of it, but...
The reason I wanted to come to Enoshima is because Mama told me to.
Enoshima is where Mama and Papa often went on dates when they were students.
She said, "Manaka, all you do is study, and you're a little blunt, so dress up properly and go."
But look, even today, we came all this way, and I'm treating it like a history lesson...
That's one of ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s good points too, isn't it？
Thank you... yes, that's enough now.
Mama said that maybe something really strange and wonderful would happen at Enoshima...
She wouldn't tell me what it was... but it's fine now.
Two people who found each other in this big world, walking through a place they don't know, feeling each other's hearts...
There's nothing more strange and wonderful than that... That's what I realized.
So I want to ring the bell with you.
And the dragon and the heavenly maiden lived happily ever after... Just kidding.
What a sunset... is that the Bell of Dragon Love？
Yes... that bell is called the Bell of Promise. Inspired by the legend of the heavenly maiden and the dragon, they say lovers who ring it will be bound together forever.
Every one of these padlocks is a couple's heartfelt wish...
Hey, doesn't it remind you of something？ We did it too, before...
Oh... Aijo Point. Could it be that's why you wanted to come to Enoshima？
Yes, that's part of it, but...
The other day, Mama told me something.
Enoshima is where Mama and Papa often went on dates when they were students.
I see. It's a nice place, after all.
Something really strange and wonderful happened, and from that moment, Mama thought she'd end up with Papa someday...
Yes. She just wouldn't tell me what it was, though...
I thought maybe if we came together, I might figure it out.
Coming here with you today, I realized I really do love you...
...and that I want to keep walking with you like this, forever.
So I'd like to ring the bell with you.
The dragon and the heavenly maiden are together forever, right？
What a sunset... is that the Bell of Dragon Love？
Yes... that bell is called the Bell of Promise. Inspired by the legend of the heavenly maiden and the dragon, they say lovers who ring it will be bound together forever.
Geez, you still don't remember？ Before, at Atami――
Oh... Aijo Point. Could it be that's why you wanted to come to Enoshima？
Yes, that's part of it, but...
Actually... Mama said something to me.
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s mom？ What did she say？
She said, "Manaka, you're a bit of a tomboy, so I'm worried. Try harder so he thinks you're cute."
Enoshima is where Mama and Papa often went on dates when they were students. She told me in secret, without Papa knowing...
Something really strange and wonderful happened, and my always-serious Papa kissed Mama for the first time, right here...
So that's it... but what was the strange and wonderful thing？
But I wondered if Enoshima has some secret that makes girls more charming than usual, and so...
Hey, shall we ring the bell too？
It seems a little different from what I imagined.
It's a surprisingly mellow sound, huh？
Yes. But now we'll be together forever. Like the dragon and the heavenly maiden.
Hehe, hey, I want to ring the bell again.
Maybe I'm a little more used to it than the first time.
Today was fun too. The sunset is so pretty...
Do you think ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s parents always watched the sunset before going home too？
Yes, I'm sure. Papa always has such a stern face, but he's actually really romantic.
I'm sure they always watched the sunset, and then...
That was fun... but we have to go home today. Let's come again？
Yeah. When you get home, you have to tell your mom about the pictures, huh？
Yes... but I'm sure Mama won't tell me.
I think it's a secret memory just between her and Papa. And because they kept it secret, I'm sure they...
Ah！ I found something great！ Wait a sec！
Ah, looks like it's here. I wonder what series this one is... let's go！
(Looks like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ made a good memory...)
Yes. I know we can just come again, so why...
Look, the train's here. Shall we go？
Ah, look, a 20 series！ Let's hurry？
(I'm a little jealous of the Enoden...)
